about: Starter builds: shared builds that ship with the game (docs/UI.md 'Sharing builds'). Each entry is a .turnip.json in this folder, listed in Settings > Campaign admin > Shared builds and by 'starter builds' in the command bar. Add one by exporting a build (Download .turnip.json) into this folder and listing it here.
